steps.rule: A candidate enters the parameter's retained_evidence if >=1 panelist marks parameter_family_relevance: relevant with a grounded, source-resolving reason.
steps._why: Retention and certification have different consumers by design, so an invalidated relevance judgment can change the retained-evidence ledger as well as the terminal label.

R9_contested_event_reading._source: Part A §5.1, realized in §5.2 — RULING (Chat, 2026-08-14), not transcription
R9_contested_event_reading._governs: reading, not computation. No 452 product keys on contested-ness.
R9_contested_event_reading.definition: A contested inclusion is a candidate in retained_evidence whose parameter_family_relevance agreement is majority_with_dissent or split, with dissenting reasons preserved in per_panelist[].
R9_contested_event_reading.constraint_on_reading: §5.1's named cases (1/3, 2/3 relevant) are substantive disagreements and resolve to `split`. `majority_with_dissent` is NOT a contested-inclusion signature; it requires the substantive votes to agree with the dissent being an abstention.
R9_contested_event_reading.correction_of_record: Grounding invalidation does NOT convert split into majority_with_dissent. Under R7 rule 2 the invalidated vote is omitted entirely and under rule 4 the token is not_assessable. P4 never applied grounding invalidation, so the conversion has never run in either pass.

R20_pass_definitions.pass_a: As-computed replay of the frozen L1 record. May add identity and provenance wrappers. MAY NOT reinterpret the payload inside them. Proven faithful by pass_a_fidelity.json, which HALTS immediately on failure.

R21_producer_binding._why: The §7.2 census traces PRODUCTS to producers. It never asked whether the producers EXIST. Two §3.1 products declared `Code, Stage 1B step 3a/3b` — role strings — while their code lived outside the repository, and a third (452_run_censuses.py) existed but was unbound by §3.1. The census passed 72/72 throughout. A manifest built over that state would hash gate records whose producers nothing pins, so a changed producer could emit an identical-shaped record and the token would not notice.
R21_producer_binding.clause_1_producer_must_be_a_file: Every `expected_producer` must resolve to a repository FILE, or be explicitly exempted below. A role string, a path constant, a planned section, or a derivable-later note is NOT a producer. This is the clause that catches a producer which does not exist.
R21_producer_binding.clause_2_producer_must_be_bound: Every non-exempt producer file must itself be a §3.1 EXPECTED_PACKAGE_ARTIFACTS entry. This is the clause that catches a producer which exists but is unbound.
R21_producer_binding._clause_order_matters: Clause 1 before clause 2. Clause 2 alone cannot catch a role string, because a role string is not a file to look up in §3.1.
R21_producer_binding._exemption_list_lives_here_not_in_code: Recorded in this rules file rather than compiled into the census, so it is auditable rather than hidden in a source constant.

L1_P4_era_producers._basis: Bound by the 431 config manifest and the P4 signed tag `stage2-sanction-431-ef1a7af7`. That is the correct binding and it is NOT this package's. Pulling them into 452's §3.1 would collapse the layer boundary the three-layer table exists to hold.

exemptions._entry_form_note: Entries are matched against the PRODUCER HEAD — the declaration text before any em-dash commentary or parenthetical. Two entries were first written in full-declaration form and never matched; corrected 2026-08-15.

mechanical_derivation_from_committed_sou._basis: The product is byte-derived from an artifact already bound by a committed manifest, and the derivation is verifiable by hash against that source. No producing script is required because no judgment is exercised: a byte-copy is checkable by comparing digests, and a template substitution is checkable by diffing the changed keys. Added 2026-08-15 when the three §3.1 trust artifacts were created.
mechanical_derivation_from_committed_sou._audit_requirement: Every product under this exemption MUST record, in its own entry, the source it derives from and the verification performed. 452_sanction_key.pub and 452_sanction_allowed_signers are byte-identical to their 431 originals (sha256 verified); 452_sanction_policy.json changed exactly four strings, with authorized_principal, authorized_fingerprint, allowed_namespace and rule byte-identical.
mechanical_derivation_from_committed_sou._not_a_licence_to_author: This exemption covers COPYING and MECHANICAL SUBSTITUTION only. Generating key material remains Tzvi's act. No private key may be generated, read, copied or invoked under this or any exemption.
